about_short_description.short_description: Storylane helps sales and marketing teams to build and share interactive product demos for SaaS companies.

product.name: Interactive Product Demo Platform
product.description: A no-code platform that enables sales and marketing teams to create, edit, and share interactive product demos for SaaS products.

product.name: Buyer Hub
product.description: A centralized deal room that consolidates demos, videos, documents, and forms into a single link for buyers to explore multiple resources.

product.name: Agentic Demo Automation (Lily)
product.description: An AI-driven demo automation agent that creates demos instantly, automates product discovery, and qualifies leads.

product.name: Storylane Desktop App
product.description: A desktop application for recording demos beyond the browser, supporting full desktop, multi-window, and mobile app recording with AI editing features.

product.name: Enterprise Demo Platform
product.description: An enterprise-grade demo platform offering security, multi-team collaboration, advanced controls, and extensive integrations for large organizations.
